newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Smurfit buys 30 pct of Spectel for 0.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Smurfit buys 30 pct of Spectel for 0.5 mln.

text.p: Ireland's Smurfit Venture Investments Ltd said on Tuesday that it had acquired 30 per cent of the Irish teleconferencing equipment company Spectel for 0.5 million Irish pounds.
The company said in a statement the acquisition was part of a 1.0 million Irish pound investment programme following the successful completion of a management buyout in December 1996.
Spectel is a wholly-owned Irish company which designs, manufactures and markets ISDN-based digital teleconferencing systems from headquarters in Sandyford, Dublin.
Smurfit Venture Investments is a joint venture between paper and liner board maker Jefferson Smurfit Group Plc, Ireland's biggest manufacturing company, and Forbairt, a state investment agency.
